headline: Zojirushi Việt Nam blocks or challenges key AI search bots.

findings.title: AI search bots are blocked or challenged
findings.why: OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot receive HTTP 406 responses, preventing them from reading the site.
findings.fix: Update firewall or bot-protection rules so verified AI search bots are not challenged or blocked.

findings.title: Homepage does not link to key trust pages
findings.why: About, Contact, and Privacy pages are unlinked, so AI agents cannot verify who operates the site.
findings.fix: Add visible links to About, Contact, and Privacy pages from the homepage.

findings.title: Articles lack self-contained quotable passages
findings.why: Zero of two checked article pages contain 40–200 word passages that answer engines can quote.
findings.fix: Write key article points as self-contained 40–200 word paragraphs that each answer one question.

findings.title: Organization schema lacks identity and entity links
findings.why: Missing logo, description, contact details, and sameAs links weaken brand entity matching.
findings.fix: Add logo, description, contactPoint or address, and official sameAs profile links to Organization JSON-LD.

findings.title: Missing llms.txt and markdown endpoints
findings.why: AI crawlers get HTTP 404 on /llms.txt and cannot retrieve clean markdown versions of pages.
findings.fix: Publish /llms.txt and serve markdown via Accept: text/markdown headers and .md URLs.
